decisions.statement: A chapter is written through the offline writer and read back here in one test.
That test takes its keys from the writer rather than from a page built to fit.
A writer keeping a page here holds only the keys that writer asked the store for.
`id` is the one key a held page must have.
Every other page key is optional here and judged only where a held page has that key.
A key this module names nothing about is handed back to the reader unchanged.
No key that no writer in the repository produces is required of a held page.

definition: the shape a held index of content pages is kept in
